home.ctaTitle: Power your home with modern and efficient solar solutions
home.ctaText: Certified solar specialists and 24/7 customer support, ready to help with your next project.

faq.a: Solar energy is power captured from sunlight and converted into electricity by photovoltaic panels. It is clean, renewable and cuts your electricity bills.

faq.q: How much energy do solar panels generate?
faq.a: Depending on system size, orientation and usage, a well-designed system can cover anywhere from 60% to 100% of a household's electricity needs.

faq.q: Do solar panels work on cloudy days?
faq.a: Yes. Panels still produce electricity under cloud cover, only at a reduced output. Battery storage can balance production and consumption.

faq.q: How long do solar panels last?
faq.a: Quality panels typically last 25–30 years and are covered by long performance warranties.

legal.privacyBody: We collect only the information you give us when you place an order, book an appointment or contact us (such as your name, phone number, email and address). We use it to process your request, deliver products and services and contact you about them. We do not sell your personal data. You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data at any time by contacting us.
legal.termsBody: Orders placed through this website are confirmed by our team by phone or WhatsApp. Prices are shown in the currency set for each product and may change without notice. Availability, delivery and installation schedules are confirmed at the time of order confirmation. Payment is made by cash on delivery or bank transfer. For any questions about warranty and returns, please contact us.
